content.case.mfg-leads.story.0: An 800-person precision parts maker adds ~40 CRM leads daily. Sales said high-value leads were first touched 2–3 hours later — after competitors.
content.case.mfg-leads.story.1: **First pilot**: “Full-auto outbound” as the first scenario. After 4 weeks, sales pushed back — uncontrolled scripts, poor CX, unclear attribution. IT raised compliance concerns; pilot stopped.
content.case.mfg-leads.story.2: **Pivot**: “Agent drafts + human confirms before send.” Within 30 minutes of a new CRM lead, the agent drafts follow-up from the profile; sales reviews and sends in one click.
content.case.mfg-leads.story.3: **Acceptance**: 200 anonymized real leads — P50 first response 3.2h → 28 min, 72% adoption. Sales lead and IT signed off; project moved to commercial approval.
content.case.mfg-leads.story.4: **Shareable pack**: Case detail and [one-pager](/downloads/one-pager-mfg.pdf) on [Cases](/cases); peers can browse [Manufacturing solutions](/industry/mfg).
content.case.mfg-leads.story.5: **Lesson**: Keep a [human-confirm path](/trust/security-faq) for the first scenario; agree metrics in writing — honest pivots pass internal review better than “full auto” hype.

content.trust.security-whitepaper.title: BlockHub Information Security Whitepaper
content.trust.security-whitepaper.subtit: Enterprise assessment · data residency · encryption & access · deletion
For enterprise IT and security teams — BlockHub practices for storage, transport encryption, access control, and deletion.
Cross-check with the [Trust Center](/trust); for full DPA and compliance alignment, [book a demo](/#contact-demo) for the qualification pack.
Customer business data (app config, KB docs, forms, etc.) is stored by default in **mainland China** data centers.
Without written customer authorization, data is **not used** for model training or shared with third parties for marketing.
Cross-border access requires explicit enablement and supplemental terms; overseas admin login is off by default.
Admin and employee endpoints use **HTTPS/TLS 1.2+** end-to-end; APIs support mTLS (hybrid/private optional).
Data at rest uses **AES-256**; keys in cloud KMS or customer HSM (private deploy optional).
Sensitive fields (phone, ID, etc.) support column-level masking and export controls.
Critical actions (login, permission changes, export, agent publish) are **fully logged** — default 180 days, extendable to 1 year.
CSV/JSON export supported; field reference in [audit log sample](/trust/audit-log).
Within **30 calendar days** of contract end or written request, data is deleted with confirmation letter.
Backups cleared per rolling policy; sub-processor deletion confirmation available.
